protocol.scenario: Class-IL (van de Ven & Tolias): new classes per task, task identity NOT given at test time
protocol.metrics: GEM formulas (Lopez-Paz & Ranzato 2017): ACC, BWT, forgetting
protocol.phi: task1_only = PRIMARY (frozen after task 1); generic_frozen = declared upper bound that LEAKS future tasks; phi_dim=32 (≥16 binding, PREREG_CL_PHI §7)
protocol.store: designed Gaussian wells over φ(x), payload = class label, MVC-0 controller (admission + placement + class-balanced eviction + scheduled decay). No exemplar is stored.
protocol.memory: matched at 200 items for the store, ER, iCaRL, GDumb and the kNN-in-φ launders; float counts reported too
protocol.filing_rule: CM-23(n) — best rehearsal-free is the claim; 'beats replay' is never claimed
protocol.known_null: EWC/SI/LwF collapse to ≈chance in Class-IL by construction (van de Ven & Tolias 2019); their collapse is NOT a CLU win
protocol.r1_naming: scheduled per-item retention; forbidden: certified, unlearning, deletion by construction, exact deletion

verdict.filing_rule: CM-23(n): winning the rehearsal-free class while sitting below replay IS a publishable success. 'Beats replay' is NEVER claimed.
verdict.laundering_rule: N89/CM-22(i): if kNN-in-φ at matched memory ties or beats the entry, the win is φ's and the buffer's, not the store's — and the report says so.

retry_native.label: mid_stream_seed0
retry_native.no_oracle_note: No mask oracle exists in this regime: the corruption is applied in PIXEL space and the store is addressed in φ, so there is no known-erased coordinate subset of the store's space to hand a baseline (this is exactly the 'space the store is not metric-native to' that w24's headroom-retry-benchmark named as the only untested route). The honest floor is kNN-in-φ (= the laundering control), reported at matched compute.

evictions.note: two causes of forgetting, never conflated: 'schedule' = the well decayed below amp_floor (the DIAL), 'budget' = the class-balanced eviction policy made room for a new item (the CAPACITY). Permanent (leak=0) items are exempt from both.

law.naming: scheduled per-item retention / scheduled forgetting — a capability of the store, NOT unlearning, NOT deletion, NOT a privacy claim (CM-22 m/n/o)
